3d20bbc62168b198862b59c1367346f35bf3624f.english: We do not choose our family, whereas friendships often develop around shared interests or a way of seeing life. We can be fond of our brother without wanting the same things or having many personal conversations.

5def7d7c7ebcfecb5e7e11fda5005cade4d2025e.english: In short, a family member can be our best friend, but they are not our best friend simply because they are our brother or cousin. The difference is the trust we build together.

66b4a1d05dd8c089992122942a613ee733d8f347.english: An adult might first tell a friend that they’d like to leave a secure job to learn carpentry. They dare to talk about their doubts without having to immediately reassure their parents about their income, and then present them with a clearer plan.

7913aaea581c62a1a59cca1211099e28ed35e398.english: Parents are used to protecting their children. Even as adults, we may fear worrying or disappointing them. A friend does not have the same expectations: we can think things through with them without immediately involving the whole family.

e77dbcfb00dd8acc292678bf38f439ac13182be0.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

f207e6e2d45fa46711d7da4292be4d51acaa2374.english: Common interests can therefore bring us closer to someone who isn’t part of our family.
f207e6e2d45fa46711d7da4292be4d51acaa2374.french: Les affinités peuvent donc nous rapprocher d'une personne qui n'est pas de notre famille.

f30440f422d583eb9f876909558c1c8a0cee1159.english: Furthermore, family roles can influence what we feel comfortable sharing.
f30440f422d583eb9f876909558c1c8a0cee1159.french: Ensuite, les rôles familiaux peuvent influencer ce que l'on ose raconter.

f73b8e7c7367f475f59e26b5da9f6b1d367087e1.english: Someone might enjoy meals with their cousins, but prefer to discuss music and go to concerts with a friend they met through a club. This doesn’t diminish their affection for their family: they simply share something else with this friend.
f73b8e7c7367f475f59e26b5da9f6b1d367087e1.french: Une personne peut apprécier les repas avec ses cousins, mais préférer discuter de musique et aller à des concerts avec une amie rencontrée dans une association. Cela ne diminue pas son affection familiale : elle partage simplement autre chose avec cette amie.

fad50427b11dcff7bb4458d03b0d089448fb5e86.deepl_english: A woman confides in her sister about her plans to move to another town. Her sister respects her choice and helps her compare properties without repeating what she’s told, even though she’s sorry to see her go.

fad50427b11dcff7bb4458d03b0d089448fb5e86.french: Une femme confie à sa sœur son projet de déménager dans une autre ville. Celle-ci respecte son choix et l'aide à comparer les logements sans répéter ses confidences, même si elle regrette de la voir partir.

fb2fbe2e7c1692d48473a8e70b552bab787ed1cb.english: A woman tells her female cousin that she wants to move, before telling her parents. Her cousin would prefer her to stay, but listens to her reasons, respects her choice and keeps it confidential.
fb2fbe2e7c1692d48473a8e70b552bab787ed1cb.french: Une femme confie à sa cousine son envie de déménager, avant d'en parler à ses parents. Sa cousine préfère qu'elle reste, mais écoute ses raisons, respecte son choix et garde cette confidence.
fb2fbe2e7c1692d48473a8e70b552bab787ed1cb.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

076cc97bd2fd9c9c543c66b3925f380f41e96477.english: Some costs do not go down when you live alone. An internet subscription, for example, can cost the same for one person as for two. Sharing these costs as a family can leave each person with more money.
076cc97bd2fd9c9c543c66b3925f380f41e96477.french: Certaines dépenses ne baissent pas quand on vit seul. Un abonnement internet, par exemple, peut coûter le même prix pour une personne que pour deux. En famille, partager ces frais peut laisser davantage de moyens à chacun.
076cc97bd2fd9c9c543c66b3925f380f41e96477.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

1041708912c705f194932f6273e50e2ca1e5bcdb.english: Two sisters share the cost of an internet subscription of forty euros a month, which works out at twenty euros each. If they each take out the same subscription in separate homes, they end up paying for two subscriptions instead of one: each would then have to pay forty euros.
1041708912c705f194932f6273e50e2ca1e5bcdb.french: Deux sœurs paient ensemble un abonnement Internet de quarante euros par mois, soit vingt euros chacune. Si elles prennent chacune le même abonnement dans des logements séparés, elles paient deux abonnements au lieu d'un : chacune doit alors payer quarante euros.

20b6c6527fecbbdc2b7f24787931139b5727677c.english: In short, living alone makes it easier to make decisions, but not necessarily to manage everything. I would choose according to my need for freedom, my means and the quality of the possible living arrangement.
20b6c6527fecbbdc2b7f24787931139b5727677c.french: En bref, vivre seul est plus facile pour décider, pas forcément pour tout assumer. Je choisirais selon mes besoins de liberté, mes moyens et la qualité de la cohabitation possible.
20b6c6527fecbbdc2b7f24787931139b5727677c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

255e76fd0fd42e5b9cf8fb2abbe08419ef2a158c.english: After an operation that limits their mobility, someone living alone arranges shopping and meals with a loved one or a service. In a family home, someone can more easily bring them what they need.
255e76fd0fd42e5b9cf8fb2abbe08419ef2a158c.french: Après une opération qui limite ses déplacements, une personne seule organise les courses et les repas avec un proche ou un service. En famille, quelqu'un peut plus facilement lui apporter ce dont elle a besoin.
255e76fd0fd42e5b9cf8fb2abbe08419ef2a158c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

26bd18924e430f17439f220806a64e89ec9251c5.english: Sharing responsibilities can make some days easier, without the work itself disappearing.

2d3c5a67bd034d00760d2c5f466631dc51542161.english: A nurse comes home after a night shift and sleeps in a quiet flat. In a family home, others might be getting ready for school or work, which would mean finding a compromise.
2d3c5a67bd034d00760d2c5f466631dc51542161.french: Une infirmière rentre après une garde de nuit et dort dans un appartement calme. En famille, les autres se prépareraient peut-être pour l'école ou le travail, ce qui obligerait à chercher un compromis.
2d3c5a67bd034d00760d2c5f466631dc51542161.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

318656bb100c827110dc1c516c370f01a9b66ad2.english: Each spends twice as much for the same service. On a small budget, this difference matters.
318656bb100c827110dc1c516c370f01a9b66ad2.french: Pour le même service, chacune dépense deux fois plus. Sur un petit budget, cette différence compte.
318656bb100c827110dc1c516c370f01a9b66ad2.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

31a6014be4d5f5b109ba1fba90bf57afa2f7303a.english: Finally, well-organised shared living allows practical tasks to be shared out.
31a6014be4d5f5b109ba1fba90bf57afa2f7303a.french: Enfin, une cohabitation bien organisée permet de répartir le travail pratique.

31e7205f903f38deb543bcad5811d2409ffd9135.english: You don’t have to coordinate every meal or every activity with the other occupants. For someone who needs peace and quiet or flexible hours, this freedom can be very welcome.
31e7205f903f38deb543bcad5811d2409ffd9135.french: On n'a pas à coordonner chaque repas ou chaque activité avec les autres occupants. Pour une personne qui a besoin de calme ou d'horaires souples, cette liberté peut être très appréciable.

37751792fb5bd33b2ae150959dbca2aa1f4c136c.english: Living alone may make it easier to organise your day, but I wouldn’t say that applies to every aspect of life. You need to weigh up the freedom to make decisions against the costs and the day-to-day work involved. Family life has its constraints, but it can also lighten certain burdens.
37751792fb5bd33b2ae150959dbca2aa1f4c136c.french: Vivre seul peut être plus facile pour organiser sa journée, mais je ne le dirais pas pour tous les aspects de la vie. Il faut comparer la liberté de décider, les dépenses et le travail quotidien. La vie en famille a des contraintes, mais peut aussi alléger certaines charges.

3c0fdc9c3430a23a8eafa35488c5e182b9344837.deepl_english: Someone who comes home late from work can prepare a simple meal and then go to bed. They do not have to wait for a shared dinner or organise their evening around others.
3c0fdc9c3430a23a8eafa35488c5e182b9344837.english: Someone who comes home late from work can prepare a simple meal and then rest. They do not have to wait for a shared dinner or organise their evening around others.
3c0fdc9c3430a23a8eafa35488c5e182b9344837.french: Une personne qui rentre tard du travail peut préparer un repas simple puis aller se reposer. Elle n'a pas à attendre un dîner commun ni à organiser sa soirée en fonction des autres.
3c0fdc9c3430a23a8eafa35488c5e182b9344837.review_note: Se reposer allows resting without going to bed; preserve the same person's freedom to organise their evening without narrowing rest to sleep.

43631ac673ec690dd6c9281c5a71e6b629b81f1a.english: In short, living alone makes some choices easier, but can cost more and require more planning. Family life can be easier if costs and chores are genuinely shared.
43631ac673ec690dd6c9281c5a71e6b629b81f1a.french: En bref, vivre seul facilite certains choix, mais peut coûter plus cher et demander plus d'organisation. La vie en famille peut être plus facile si les frais et les tâches sont réellement partagés.
43631ac673ec690dd6c9281c5a71e6b629b81f1a.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

4a35d71380fcf0411f0c5740366efd3247704401.english: Next, living alone means paying certain household expenses from a single income.
4a35d71380fcf0411f0c5740366efd3247704401.french: Ensuite, vivre seul signifie payer certaines charges avec un seul revenu.
4a35d71380fcf0411f0c5740366efd3247704401.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

53a8aaf377bb8af00b5093b3c5677690311a4bd9.english: Living together obviously only helps if relationships are respectful and chores are shared. If one person does everything for the others, living alone can be a relief. Living alone does not, after all, prevent a rich social life.
53a8aaf377bb8af00b5093b3c5677690311a4bd9.french: La cohabitation n'aide évidemment que si les relations sont respectueuses et les tâches partagées. Si une personne fait tout pour les autres, vivre seule peut être un soulagement. Habiter seul n'empêche d'ailleurs pas d'avoir une vie sociale riche.
53a8aaf377bb8af00b5093b3c5677690311a4bd9.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

5594f9be63998d2ab36c1f3cac821069f155a88b.english: In a couple, one person comes home early and prepares dinner. The other finishes late that evening but will do the shopping the next day. The meal is already ready when they return, allowing them to rest.
5594f9be63998d2ab36c1f3cac821069f155a88b.french: Dans un couple, l'un rentre tôt et prépare le dîner. L'autre finit tard ce soir-là, mais fera les courses le lendemain. Le repas est déjà prêt à son retour, ce qui lui permet de se reposer.

5d31e669dc3dcf0f972319b3f98dbe604f55ddf3.english: Living alone can make organising the day simpler, but not every aspect of daily life. You choose your routines without negotiating with others. On the other hand, expenses are no longer shared and help has to be arranged differently. It all depends on what you mean by an easy life.
5d31e669dc3dcf0f972319b3f98dbe604f55ddf3.french: Vivre seul peut simplifier l'organisation de la journée, mais pas tout le quotidien. On choisit ses habitudes sans négocier avec les autres. En revanche, les dépenses ne sont plus partagées et l'aide doit s'organiser autrement. Tout dépend de ce qu'on appelle une vie facile.
5d31e669dc3dcf0f972319b3f98dbe604f55ddf3.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

64123069c227b01d2550c8394610d11bf65d2e8b.english: Sharing in this way can leave each person with more money for other needs.
64123069c227b01d2550c8394610d11bf65d2e8b.french: Cette répartition peut laisser davantage d'argent à chacun pour d'autres besoins.
64123069c227b01d2550c8394610d11bf65d2e8b.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

658fc1d27cb31ff1c44fb2451f8aaaf3974034c2.english: The difficulty also becomes apparent when you temporarily cannot do everything yourself.
658fc1d27cb31ff1c44fb2451f8aaaf3974034c2.french: La difficulté se voit aussi quand on ne peut temporairement plus tout faire soi-même.
658fc1d27cb31ff1c44fb2451f8aaaf3974034c2.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

671d5c3cdbaf66e045c7872b7305c492f5d2bb89.english: First and foremost, living alone allows you to choose your own pace of life more freely.
671d5c3cdbaf66e045c7872b7305c492f5d2bb89.french: Tout d'abord, vivre seul permet de choisir plus librement son rythme de vie.

67771ceba406b1763f2d2cf4250e425c6bcfc11b.english: This saves them from having to wait or change their habits to fit in with other people’s schedules.
67771ceba406b1763f2d2cf4250e425c6bcfc11b.french: Cela lui évite d'attendre ou de changer ses habitudes pour s'adapter aux horaires des autres.

68650ea3f74794b90872d26a5061722e6419f039.english: First, living alone allows you to follow your own rhythm.
68650ea3f74794b90872d26a5061722e6419f039.french: D'abord, vivre seul permet de suivre son propre rythme.
68650ea3f74794b90872d26a5061722e6419f039.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

74fd5115acc2c7eb887a501de0b8665806cdc69c.english: Living alone does not mean having no family or friends. But no one is already there to notice a problem or do you a favour. You need to plan who to call and be willing to ask for support.
74fd5115acc2c7eb887a501de0b8665806cdc69c.french: Vivre seul ne signifie pas n'avoir ni famille ni amis. Mais personne n'est déjà sur place pour remarquer un problème ou rendre un service. Il faut prévoir qui appeler et oser demander un soutien.
74fd5115acc2c7eb887a501de0b8665806cdc69c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

76f7bfd2108dce5c360af21685b519d4ec55f55a.english: Someone living alone pays the whole internet and home insurance bills. When two adults live together, they can share these bills, even if the amounts are not exactly the same.
76f7bfd2108dce5c360af21685b519d4ec55f55a.french: Une personne seule paie entièrement internet et l'assurance habitation. Lorsque deux adultes vivent ensemble, ils peuvent partager ces factures, même si les montants ne sont pas exactement identiques.
76f7bfd2108dce5c360af21685b519d4ec55f55a.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

7c5e0823b11233bfbf6fa97411a085f3d8691021.english: Housing, an internet subscription and household equipment are expensive when you do not share them. Even if you consume less, some expenses remain difficult to reduce. In a family, these costs can be shared if everyone genuinely contributes.
7c5e0823b11233bfbf6fa97411a085f3d8691021.french: Le logement, l'abonnement internet et les équipements coûtent cher quand on ne les partage pas. Même si l'on consomme moins, certaines dépenses restent difficiles à réduire. En famille, on peut répartir ces charges, si chacun contribue réellement.
7c5e0823b11233bfbf6fa97411a085f3d8691021.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

7c6967e464b642495a5b9c5d37158728381bf189.english: In my view, living alone is not necessarily easier than living with family. You can follow your own routine, but you also have more to deal with on your own. The comparison therefore depends on which costs and chores are actually shared.
7c6967e464b642495a5b9c5d37158728381bf189.french: Pour moi, vivre seul n'est pas forcément plus facile que vivre en famille. On peut suivre son propre rythme, mais on assume aussi davantage de choses seul. La comparaison dépend donc des frais et des tâches qu'on partage réellement.
7c6967e464b642495a5b9c5d37158728381bf189.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

7d236784b8d1af547692dffbf1e048833302de34.english: In conclusion, living alone makes certain choices easier, but can put a strain on your budget and make practical arrangements more difficult. You need to weigh up your actual circumstances against your priorities, rather than claiming that one way of life is easier for everyone.
7d236784b8d1af547692dffbf1e048833302de34.french: En conclusion, vivre seul facilite certains choix, mais peut alourdir le budget et l'organisation pratique. Il faut comparer les conditions réelles et ses priorités, plutôt que déclarer une forme de vie plus facile pour tout le monde.

8692ede940ca302215652ee175ee56495860ef7e.english: Living alone does not mean having no family or friends. But you must be able to get help without relying on someone already being at home. You need to ask for this support and arrange visits around everyone's availability.
8692ede940ca302215652ee175ee56495860ef7e.french: Vivre seul ne signifie pas n'avoir ni famille ni amis. Mais il faut qu'on puisse obtenir de l'aide sans compter sur quelqu'un déjà présent au logement. On doit demander ce soutien et organiser les passages selon les disponibilités de chacun.
8692ede940ca302215652ee175ee56495860ef7e.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

8a5eeda0080345f953095c022414dadf24a8f141.english: Finally, living alone can make everyday life harder when you need help.
8a5eeda0080345f953095c022414dadf24a8f141.french: Enfin, vivre seul peut compliquer le quotidien quand on a besoin d'aide.
8a5eeda0080345f953095c022414dadf24a8f141.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

8ac2dfc9743ba7155f0726ca087135c2d079cc89.english: An internet subscription or certain household equipment costs almost as much for one person as for two. Consuming less is therefore not enough to divide every bill. In a family, sharing these expenses can leave each person with more money.
8ac2dfc9743ba7155f0726ca087135c2d079cc89.french: Un abonnement internet ou certains équipements coûtent presque autant pour une personne que pour deux. Consommer moins ne suffit donc pas à diviser toutes les factures. En famille, partager ces dépenses peut laisser davantage de moyens à chacun.
8ac2dfc9743ba7155f0726ca087135c2d079cc89.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

9208d6b3893a60469085ce7402a71a146504069a.deepl_english: For the same level of care, living separately may therefore increase each person’s expenses.

9208d6b3893a60469085ce7402a71a146504069a.french: Pour le même service, vivre séparément peut donc augmenter la dépense de chacune.
9208d6b3893a60469085ce7402a71a146504069a.review_note: Service refers to the internet subscription, not a level of care.

96203a1a1837f0f47d7a85b4f428cb9f9411b760.english: Furthermore, living alone also means bearing certain expenses on one’s own.
96203a1a1837f0f47d7a85b4f428cb9f9411b760.french: Ensuite, vivre seul signifie aussi assumer seul certaines dépenses.

a87391ef3d3f28ddf3a9aa052f00af49793426b0.english: However, this sharing of responsibilities does not automatically happen within a family. If one person takes on all the tasks or if relationships are strained, living alone can become much simpler. Conversely, living alone does not prevent mutual support or a rich social life outside the home.
a87391ef3d3f28ddf3a9aa052f00af49793426b0.french: Cependant, ce partage n'existe pas automatiquement en famille. Si une seule personne assume toutes les tâches ou si les relations sont tendues, vivre seul peut devenir beaucoup plus simple. Inversement, habiter seul n'empêche ni l'entraide ni une vie sociale riche hors du logement.

ada8ca7eec5cf6df8c32673f1fe0b207c7a39472.english: This does not mean that family life is always easier. If one person does the shopping, cooking and cleaning for everyone, they carry the whole workload. For that person, living alone can mean less work day to day.
ada8ca7eec5cf6df8c32673f1fe0b207c7a39472.french: Cela ne veut pas dire que vivre en famille soit toujours plus facile. Si une seule personne fait les courses, les repas et le ménage pour tout le monde, elle porte toute la charge. Pour cette personne, vivre seule peut donc alléger le quotidien.
ada8ca7eec5cf6df8c32673f1fe0b207c7a39472.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

b6e28f35ac0d808d6e5c18aa0a51c64bbd3ecfc5.english: Finally, you must be able to get help when you can no longer do everything yourself.
b6e28f35ac0d808d6e5c18aa0a51c64bbd3ecfc5.french: Enfin, il faut qu'on puisse obtenir de l'aide lorsqu'on ne peut plus tout faire soi-même.
b6e28f35ac0d808d6e5c18aa0a51c64bbd3ecfc5.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

bb47f9b9fd17dfa25585d07cdf9e4e6cb012b2de.english: After a knee operation, someone living alone asks their sister to do the shopping on Saturday and arranges meal deliveries for the week. They organise this help before returning home.

bb47f9b9fd17dfa25585d07cdf9e4e6cb012b2de.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

c18714b0977cf9075e4de7e30e7ac49d0bd9cdd4.french: Vivre seul me paraît plus facile pour suivre son rythme, mais pas pour tout assumer. La même situation peut simplifier nos journées et compliquer notre budget. Avant de dire que c'est mieux qu'en famille, il faut donc préciser de quoi on parle.
c18714b0977cf9075e4de7e30e7ac49d0bd9cdd4.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

c5ba8bbc2178c79f6a103103861f6a634b760ecf.english: Living alone therefore makes it easier for her to rest: her home can accommodate her needs.

c5ba8bbc2178c79f6a103103861f6a634b760ecf.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d1f13dc7b6f9f530605ce34b4ed307e6b44902ed.french: Si un problème de santé nous empêche de faire les courses ou de préparer les repas, il faut qu'on puisse obtenir de l'aide. Quand on vit seul, on doit organiser ce soutien : demander à un proche quand il peut venir ou prévoir des livraisons.

d5fda3ab01f8475a6029cf2a93f56b94da04e4d6.english: Two sisters share an internet subscription costing forty euros a month: each pays twenty euros. They then move into separate homes and each takes out the same forty-euro subscription.
d5fda3ab01f8475a6029cf2a93f56b94da04e4d6.french: Deux sœurs partagent un abonnement internet à quarante euros par mois : chacune paie vingt euros. Elles prennent ensuite deux logements et souscrivent chacune le même abonnement à quarante euros.

dc4ff66644d33d12c81fb8ef85c25baa0dc7b6ef.english: A nurse comes home after a night shift and sleeps in her quiet flat. She does not have to adapt her rest to other people's morning preparations for school or work.
dc4ff66644d33d12c81fb8ef85c25baa0dc7b6ef.french: Une infirmière rentre après une garde de nuit et dort dans son appartement calme. Elle n'a pas à adapter son repos aux préparatifs du matin d'autres personnes qui partiraient à l'école ou au travail.
dc4ff66644d33d12c81fb8ef85c25baa0dc7b6ef.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

e09687bc73ae377bf270ab7d4ba7d6727a35d45a.english: An internet subscription or certain equipment can cost almost as much for one person as it does for several. In a family, certain goods and services can be shared amongst several people.
e09687bc73ae377bf270ab7d4ba7d6727a35d45a.french: Un abonnement Internet ou certains équipements peuvent coûter presque autant pour une personne que pour plusieurs. En famille, certains biens et services peuvent être utilisés par plusieurs personnes.

e404ba698a5787a8ceb6cc8b153ddd7184ce9cfe.english: They can remain independent, but this requires extra organisation during that period.
e404ba698a5787a8ceb6cc8b153ddd7184ce9cfe.french: Son autonomie reste possible, mais exige une organisation supplémentaire pendant cette période.
e404ba698a5787a8ceb6cc8b153ddd7184ce9cfe.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

e572eb7d7cca8a5659976b426caa19e44c76ba49.english: This freedom comes at a cost, however, because some expenses are no longer shared.
e572eb7d7cca8a5659976b426caa19e44c76ba49.french: Cette liberté a cependant un coût, puisque certaines dépenses ne sont plus partagées.

ea4a7a746678e804588e568c6e57971e710e12ca.english: Of course, living together only helps if relationships are respectful and chores are shared. If one person does everything or arguments are constant, living alone can be restful. And living alone does not prevent a rich social life.
ea4a7a746678e804588e568c6e57971e710e12ca.french: Bien sûr, la cohabitation n'aide que si les relations sont respectueuses et les tâches partagées. Si une personne fait tout ou si les disputes sont permanentes, vivre seul peut être reposant. Et habiter seul n'empêche pas une vie sociale riche.
ea4a7a746678e804588e568c6e57971e710e12ca.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

editorial_history.french: Elle peut rester chez elle, mais cela demande des préparatifs qu'une famille présente et disponible aurait pu lui épargner en partie.

ea783af54eb812f82d089dafd039dbe82053043f.french: Elle peut rester chez elle, mais cela demande des préparatifs qu'une famille présente et disponible aurait pu lui épargner en partie.

ee3f1e3b10271c2ddcd793f5e99c398574d552f2.english: Shopping, cooking and housework are still necessary when living alone. In a household where everyone pitches in, one person can take over when the other has a busy day.
ee3f1e3b10271c2ddcd793f5e99c398574d552f2.french: Les courses, la cuisine et l'entretien restent nécessaires quand on vit seul. Dans un foyer où chacun participe, une personne peut prendre le relais lorsque l'autre a une journée chargée.

f73e461e4de4a9f328b2135116cc88f5673bce8c.english: You choose your meals and when you want peace and quiet. This reduces the sometimes tiring negotiations when several people have different schedules. This freedom is particularly useful for someone working unusual hours.
f73e461e4de4a9f328b2135116cc88f5673bce8c.french: On choisit ses repas et les moments où l'on souhaite du calme. Cela réduit les négociations parfois fatigantes quand plusieurs personnes ont des horaires différents. Cette liberté est particulièrement utile pour quelqu'un qui travaille à des heures inhabituelles.
f73e461e4de4a9f328b2135116cc88f5673bce8c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

024788ac331ae7072c5f5f65203c77d750410188.english: A calm response allows the problem to be resolved whilst maintaining a dialogue with the child.
024788ac331ae7072c5f5f65203c77d750410188.french: Une réaction calme permet de régler le problème tout en gardant le dialogue avec l'enfant.

0d71048c03e613b8c3b063aa4d6177efdd7e15c9.english: I believe parents should set clear rules, but not make children obey out of fear. They can explain their decisions and listen to their child while still setting limits.
0d71048c03e613b8c3b063aa4d6177efdd7e15c9.french: Je suis pour des règles claires, mais pas pour une éducation fondée sur la peur. Les parents peuvent expliquer leurs décisions et écouter l'enfant sans renoncer à poser des limites.
0d71048c03e613b8c3b063aa4d6177efdd7e15c9.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

0dff0cb3b83bd717e3c165e5f8a3a1a7b882c29b.english: Finally, offering age-appropriate choices helps children become independent.
0dff0cb3b83bd717e3c165e5f8a3a1a7b882c29b.french: Enfin, laisser des choix adaptés à l'âge aide l'enfant à devenir autonome.

0edd3bee3cb9dbdbbbfe50489f268a7df89e568d.english: A young child does not appreciate every risk and sometimes puts their immediate wishes first. Rules about sleep, safety and respect are not optional. They must be consistent so that decisions are predictable.
0edd3bee3cb9dbdbbbfe50489f268a7df89e568d.french: Un jeune enfant ne mesure pas tous les risques et privilégie parfois son envie immédiate. Les règles sur le sommeil, la sécurité et le respect ne sont pas facultatives. Elles doivent être stables pour rendre les décisions prévisibles.
0edd3bee3cb9dbdbbbfe50489f268a7df89e568d.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

1054ab2f9a718b80e6d65d64892fa312d0c6639a.english: But if you enforce every rule through fear, the child may mainly learn to keep quiet.
1054ab2f9a718b80e6d65d64892fa312d0c6639a.french: Mais si on fait respecter toutes les règles par la peur, l'enfant risque surtout de se taire.
1054ab2f9a718b80e6d65d64892fa312d0c6639a.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

1a55bc7b5dcd8045b322944bdbed6b11a655286e.english: The child continues his activity and the baby can sleep. The rule meets a need he can understand.
1a55bc7b5dcd8045b322944bdbed6b11a655286e.french: L'enfant continue son activité et le bébé peut dormir. La règle répond à un besoin qu'il peut comprendre.
1a55bc7b5dcd8045b322944bdbed6b11a655286e.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

1befe407ae82f7f0807af1925ec9d6d938cd9c05.english: I therefore support firm rules without using fear to impose them. The parent remains responsible for the framework, but gradually helps the child understand and act without waiting for an order.
1befe407ae82f7f0807af1925ec9d6d938cd9c05.french: Je suis donc pour des règles fermes, sans faire de la peur le moyen de les imposer. Le parent reste responsable du cadre, mais aide peu à peu l'enfant à comprendre et à agir sans attendre un ordre.
1befe407ae82f7f0807af1925ec9d6d938cd9c05.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

20294a5f9c85838ccd08922e1e32154d9a984bbc.english: When the baby is having a nap, his seven-year-old brother must play without making too much noise. His father explains why and suggests he draw in another room. The child can continue to keep himself occupied whilst the baby sleeps.
20294a5f9c85838ccd08922e1e32154d9a984bbc.french: Quand le bébé fait sa sieste, son frère de sept ans doit jouer sans faire trop de bruit. Son père lui explique pourquoi et lui propose de dessiner dans une autre pièce. L'enfant peut continuer à s'occuper pendant que le bébé dort.

208920c8b093e65403b19794c80ffb0ceb13f02f.english: The child keeps playing without using the siren. He can still enjoy his game while letting the baby sleep.
208920c8b093e65403b19794c80ffb0ceb13f02f.french: L'enfant continue à jouer sans faire sonner la sirène. Il peut ainsi s'amuser tout en laissant le bébé dormir.
208920c8b093e65403b19794c80ffb0ceb13f02f.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

238fb6bef752fa1b52f4fad6944a32e4cfe36a36.english: After damaging a library book, a child hesitates to show it, then tells their parent about it. The parent listens without shouting and helps them contact the library to find out how to replace it. The child can thus make amends for their mistake rather than hiding it.
238fb6bef752fa1b52f4fad6944a32e4cfe36a36.french: Après avoir abîmé un livre de bibliothèque, un enfant hésite à le montrer, puis en parle à son parent. Celui-ci l'écoute sans crier et l'aide à contacter la bibliothèque pour savoir comment le remplacer. L'enfant peut ainsi réparer son erreur au lieu de la cacher.

3bea1de26feb0dccef9b95870e7df9b5a067d948.english: A young child thinks about what they want to do without always seeing the needs of those around them. The parent needs to set a limit, but also explain the reason and suggest a way to carry on differently.
3bea1de26feb0dccef9b95870e7df9b5a067d948.french: Un jeune enfant pense à ce qu'il a envie de faire sans toujours voir les besoins autour de lui. Le parent doit poser une limite, mais aussi en expliquer la raison et proposer une façon de continuer autrement.
3bea1de26feb0dccef9b95870e7df9b5a067d948.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

3d12c801ce180e73a6635a21e5aef3c8e2efd7e4.english: A teenager hides a poor mark for fear of being humiliated. If they can show their marked work without being belittled, their parents can look with them at what they have not understood.
3d12c801ce180e73a6635a21e5aef3c8e2efd7e4.french: Un adolescent cache une mauvaise note par peur d'être humilié. S'il peut montrer sa copie sans être rabaissé, ses parents peuvent regarder avec lui ce qu'il n'a pas compris.
3d12c801ce180e73a6635a21e5aef3c8e2efd7e4.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

42077d99b90fef7b6ffa380f7e370b0e271a88ec.english: Discussion addresses the real difficulty, whereas fear may make it invisible.
42077d99b90fef7b6ffa380f7e370b0e271a88ec.french: La discussion traite la difficulté réelle, alors que la peur risque de la rendre invisible.
42077d99b90fef7b6ffa380f7e370b0e271a88ec.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

49ea83faf13132068d3013b6d3e6b85d4949c0aa.english: Furthermore, a child who fears being humiliated may hesitate to ask for help.
49ea83faf13132068d3013b6d3e6b85d4949c0aa.french: Ensuite, un enfant qui craint d'être humilié peut hésiter à demander de l'aide.

59ba51de067ccffa787545b31b8670dbf07bc960.english: While the baby is having a nap, a father asks his seven-year-old son to make less noise. He explains that the baby is sleeping and suggests drawing in another room.

59ba51de067ccffa787545b31b8670dbf07bc960.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

6407ab4ca29ad9f9d8932e688398051c2557df09.english: A child has damaged a library book and dares to tell their parent. The parent listens without shouting; together, they contact the library to find out how to replace the book.
6407ab4ca29ad9f9d8932e688398051c2557df09.french: Un enfant a abîmé un livre de bibliothèque et ose le dire à son parent. Celui-ci l'écoute sans crier ; ensemble, ils contactent la bibliothèque pour savoir comment remplacer le livre.
6407ab4ca29ad9f9d8932e688398051c2557df09.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

686a5f2db8a98336ed8de76a0a8b947a4a2d03c1.english: A child wants to keep playing before a school day. Their parent understands their disappointment, but maintains bedtime. The parent gives them five minutes' warning before playtime ends.
686a5f2db8a98336ed8de76a0a8b947a4a2d03c1.french: Un enfant veut continuer à jouer avant une journée d'école. Son parent comprend sa déception, mais maintient l'heure du coucher. Il le prévient cinq minutes avant la fin du jeu.
686a5f2db8a98336ed8de76a0a8b947a4a2d03c1.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

6d4c1474cb04085e92e357bda6abf46497971c8e.english: Listening does not mean negotiating everything. Near a road, you must intervene immediately if a child puts themselves in danger, then explain afterwards. For a matter that poses no danger, you can listen to their views and reconsider a rule they have outgrown.
6d4c1474cb04085e92e357bda6abf46497971c8e.french: Écouter ne signifie pas tout négocier. Près d'une route, il faut intervenir immédiatement si l'enfant se met en danger, puis expliquer après. Pour une question sans danger, on peut entendre son avis et revoir une règle devenue inadaptée à son âge.
6d4c1474cb04085e92e357bda6abf46497971c8e.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

70a3b7d46a1ee0b5232f2e1d56a6dea09dae3549.english: He learns to organise his work within a framework set by his parent. Trust thus rests on a commitment he keeps.
70a3b7d46a1ee0b5232f2e1d56a6dea09dae3549.french: Il apprend à organiser son travail dans un cadre fixé par le parent. La confiance repose ainsi sur un engagement qu'il respecte.
70a3b7d46a1ee0b5232f2e1d56a6dea09dae3549.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

76d57817ab66e5e1052caa6cf377b0ace361c951.english: If being authoritarian means imposing all decisions without listening to the child, I disagree. That does not mean abandoning boundaries. For me, it is about explaining the rules, listening to the child and gradually teaching them to make decisions.
76d57817ab66e5e1052caa6cf377b0ace361c951.french: Si être autoritaire signifie imposer toutes les décisions sans écouter l'enfant, je ne suis pas d'accord. Cela ne veut pas dire renoncer aux limites. Pour moi, il faut expliquer les règles, écouter l'enfant et lui apprendre peu à peu à décider.

7fc1628fc0027ab2c5c6e4c29b6970752532f4d9.english: If a child expects to be shouted at before they’ve even had a chance to explain themselves, they may hide what has happened. The problem then remains unresolved, and the parent cannot help them.
7fc1628fc0027ab2c5c6e4c29b6970752532f4d9.french: S'il s'attend à des cris avant même d'avoir pu s'expliquer, il risque de cacher ce qui s'est passé. Le problème reste alors sans solution, et le parent ne peut pas l'aider.

8011cf8ee11d0eba30a1a0cbd6a9f3d4688c0372.english: While the baby is having a nap, a seven-year-old boy sounds the siren on his toy truck. His father tells him, 'You can keep playing, but without the siren, so the baby can sleep.'
8011cf8ee11d0eba30a1a0cbd6a9f3d4688c0372.french: Pendant la sieste du bébé, un garçon de sept ans fait sonner la sirène de son camion jouet. Son père lui dit : « Tu peux continuer à jouer, mais sans la sirène, pour laisser dormir le bébé. »
8011cf8ee11d0eba30a1a0cbd6a9f3d4688c0372.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

8504b331da9f5501f4cd9f9628fa7b57330e000d.english: A teenager must be home before 10 pm because transport becomes infrequent afterwards. They choose their outing, check their route and let their parents know if they are delayed.
8504b331da9f5501f4cd9f9628fa7b57330e000d.french: Un adolescent doit rentrer avant vingt-deux heures parce que les transports deviennent rares ensuite. Il choisit sa sortie, vérifie son trajet et prévient en cas de retard.
8504b331da9f5501f4cd9f9628fa7b57330e000d.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

88dd3b1e91b32011310a4c25c0df4c36c75e8d5d.english: The rule therefore helps the child to respect their little brother’s sleep.
88dd3b1e91b32011310a4c25c0df4c36c75e8d5d.french: La règle aide donc l'enfant à respecter le sommeil de son petit frère.

8ddfd5ace424f601a27974e8129a4d287b16256d.english: However, discussing matters does not mean that every rule must be endlessly negotiated. When faced with immediate danger, an adult must act first and explain afterwards. A boundary can be upheld firmly without threats or humiliation, and listening does not mean you have to accept every request.
8ddfd5ace424f601a27974e8129a4d287b16256d.french: Cependant, discuter ne signifie pas que chaque règle doit être négociée sans fin. Devant un danger immédiat, l'adulte doit intervenir d'abord et expliquer ensuite. Une limite peut rester ferme sans menaces ni humiliation, et l'écoute n'oblige pas à accepter toute demande.

977b240d64701fc0a1f9b4c56ba5b6976cc00f72.english: A teenager wants to unwind after coming home from school and suggests starting his homework at 5.00 pm. His mother agrees, on condition that it is finished before dinner. A week later, he is sticking to this timetable without her having to remind him every evening.
977b240d64701fc0a1f9b4c56ba5b6976cc00f72.french: Un adolescent veut souffler en rentrant du collège et propose de commencer ses devoirs à dix-sept heures. Sa mère accepte, à condition qu'ils soient terminés avant le dîner. Une semaine plus tard, il respecte cet horaire sans qu'elle ait à le lui rappeler chaque soir.

9ff4aedab5832ccaadcf939c9ed0484e45475ec4.english: The child takes part in putting their mistake right instead of hiding it. Listening to them has not removed their responsibility.
9ff4aedab5832ccaadcf939c9ed0484e45475ec4.french: Il prend part à la réparation de son erreur au lieu de la cacher. L'écouter n'a pas supprimé sa responsabilité.
9ff4aedab5832ccaadcf939c9ed0484e45475ec4.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

a818126a8a719de290a64cbf262e3b8504ad83cb.english: In conclusion, I prefer firm, consistent and well-explained authority to authoritarianism. Clear rules, the opportunity to have a say and age-appropriate choices help children to become independent, not just to obey.
a818126a8a719de290a64cbf262e3b8504ad83cb.french: En conclusion, je préfère une autorité ferme, cohérente et expliquée à l'autoritarisme. Des règles claires, la possibilité de parler et des choix adaptés à l'âge aident l'enfant à devenir autonome, pas seulement à obéir.

b0690ae86c6da3f4e53e3ddc7eb93c26b212d811.english: So I do not support authoritarianism. Fair, firm and explained authority protects children today while preparing them to decide for themselves tomorrow.
b0690ae86c6da3f4e53e3ddc7eb93c26b212d811.french: Donc, je ne suis pas pour l'autoritarisme. Une autorité juste, ferme et expliquée protège l'enfant aujourd'hui tout en le préparant à décider seul demain.
b0690ae86c6da3f4e53e3ddc7eb93c26b212d811.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b0943df8b9e846e19e51231ff95ba9b1b4b5e974.english: Parents can set out what needs to be done without deciding every single detail. The aim is not for parents to decide everything indefinitely, but for children to learn to organise themselves.
b0943df8b9e846e19e51231ff95ba9b1b4b5e974.french: Le parent peut fixer ce qui doit être fait sans décider de chaque détail. L'objectif n'est pas que le parent décide de tout indéfiniment, mais que l'enfant apprenne à s'organiser.

b75793a73c8a7efc2cace883ba9fae3e8b5ebcc4.english: Parents can decide what needs to be done, then let the child suggest how to do it. Giving children choices suited to their age helps them learn to make decisions and follow through on what they have agreed to do.
b75793a73c8a7efc2cace883ba9fae3e8b5ebcc4.french: Les parents peuvent fixer ce qui doit être fait, puis laisser l'enfant proposer comment s'organiser. Avec des choix adaptés à son âge, l'enfant apprend à prendre des décisions et à respecter les engagements qu'il a lui-même pris.
b75793a73c8a7efc2cace883ba9fae3e8b5ebcc4.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

b7e73fbba50418efd827ce029b569c988aeb6149.english: Finally, the aim is not for children always to obey, but for them to learn to choose.
b7e73fbba50418efd827ce029b569c988aeb6149.french: Enfin, le but n'est pas que l'enfant obéisse toujours, mais qu'il apprenne à choisir.
b7e73fbba50418efd827ce029b569c988aeb6149.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

337270e55e2e32697b8630c02eac5b2a93cd61c3.english: If a promised outing is cancelled because a parent has to work, they can simply say so and acknowledge the child’s disappointment. 3662d6bd01d24d1960f0d48e804dd27ba375fc77.english: However, children do not need to know about every conflict or every detail of adults’ private lives. You can tell them that a question is personal or that you do not yet have an answer. Being honest does not mean telling them everything.

3bba67ca5e53dbb1818bf34eebfc0ec47a516ec9.english: A child notices absences or new habits without necessarily knowing the reason behind them. Without an explanation, they may imagine something far more serious than the reality.

6f73414ba279f23f249e1d722d54930db6097f78.english: She understands why her grandmother is absent and can keep talking to her, rather than being left alone with her questions.

77403ce41aa4424412c83dd0b3fc1bbbbb1ec349.english: They see absences and changing routines. Without an explanation, they may imagine something more worrying than the reality. The truth must therefore be adapted to their age, with simple words and time for their questions.
77403ce41aa4424412c83dd0b3fc1bbbbb1ec349.french: Il voit les absences et les habitudes qui changent. Sans explication, il peut imaginer quelque chose de plus inquiétant que la réalité. Il faut donc que la vérité soit adaptée à son âge, avec des mots simples et du temps pour ses questions.
77403ce41aa4424412c83dd0b3fc1bbbbb1ec349.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

8864bfd0c9208ffb87ac18ab1eab9ce5f10ab335.english: The truth becomes a starting point for moving forward, not a way of belittling them.
8864bfd0c9208ffb87ac18ab1eab9ce5f10ab335.french: La vérité devient un point de départ pour progresser, pas une manière de rabaisser.

8f10566fce5207c06bacc00582bcc80969841df0.english: Before a vaccination, you can say: "You will feel a little prick, but it does not last long and I will stay with you." That is better than promising they will not feel anything.
8f10566fce5207c06bacc00582bcc80969841df0.french: Avant un vaccin, on peut dire : « Tu vas sentir une petite piqûre, mais ça dure peu de temps et je reste avec toi. » C'est mieux que promettre qu'il ne sentira rien.
8f10566fce5207c06bacc00582bcc80969841df0.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

940d3c69c1f95fcc2828768948875a9c7e113131.english: Finally, an honest answer can also help a child improve.
940d3c69c1f95fcc2828768948875a9c7e113131.french: Enfin, une réponse honnête peut aussi aider l'enfant à progresser.
940d3c69c1f95fcc2828768948875a9c7e113131.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

a1de6e13c792e21a7ae06f0027a061addc82d946.english: A little girl no longer sees her grandmother on Wednesdays. Her parents explain that she is in hospital after a fall and arrange a call, without promising that she will recover straight away.
a1de6e13c792e21a7ae06f0027a061addc82d946.french: Une fillette ne voit plus sa grand-mère le mercredi. Ses parents expliquent qu'elle est à l'hôpital après une chute et organisent un appel, sans promettre qu'elle guérira tout de suite.
a1de6e13c792e21a7ae06f0027a061addc82d946.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

a3ced2c9191edeac94b71adcf04533d136fc30c5.english: A false promise can reassure a child in the moment. But if they discover they have been lied to, they may trust their parents less. An honest answer, on the other hand, helps them know what to expect.
a3ced2c9191edeac94b71adcf04533d136fc30c5.french: Une fausse promesse peut rassurer l'enfant sur le moment. Mais s'il découvre qu'on lui a menti, il risque de moins faire confiance à ses parents. Une réponse honnête l'aide au contraire à savoir à quoi s'attendre.
a3ced2c9191edeac94b71adcf04533d136fc30c5.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

ae929e8bfbff5c7c36c8c48cf1b0f02fa8a165f5.english: Before playing the piano in front of the class, the child asks whether they are ready. You can answer: "You know the beginning well, but you hesitate at the end. We can go over it together."
ae929e8bfbff5c7c36c8c48cf1b0f02fa8a165f5.french: Avant de jouer du piano devant la classe, il demande s'il est prêt. On peut répondre : « Tu connais bien le début, mais tu hésites à la fin. On peut la reprendre ensemble. »
ae929e8bfbff5c7c36c8c48cf1b0f02fa8a165f5.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b52a625efeda41e5758dfaf5e684efad963c7b3b.english: For me, it is better to tell children a simple truth than to invent a story to avoid a difficult conversation. Honesty maintains trust and helps them understand what they are going through. But it does not mean telling them everything as though they were adults.
b52a625efeda41e5758dfaf5e684efad963c7b3b.french: Pour moi, il vaut mieux dire une vérité simple aux enfants qu'inventer une histoire pour éviter une conversation difficile. L'honnêteté entretient la confiance et les aide à comprendre ce qu'ils vivent. Mais elle ne signifie pas tout raconter comme à un adulte.
b52a625efeda41e5758dfaf5e684efad963c7b3b.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b82ddbfb60940b13959769b313f936433e6c4c0f.english: They hear an argument or see a parent crying. Without an explanation, they may invent an answer and believe they are responsible. The truth must therefore be adapted to their age, with simple words and time for their questions.
b82ddbfb60940b13959769b313f936433e6c4c0f.french: Ils entendent une dispute ou voient un parent pleurer. Sans explication, ils peuvent inventer une réponse et se croire responsables. Il faut donc que la vérité soit adaptée à leur âge, avec des mots simples et du temps pour leurs questions.
b82ddbfb60940b13959769b313f936433e6c4c0f.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b9ae8e6e26cf53d252621760ca99bb37795779de.english: I believe we should prioritise the truth with children, but ‘always’ does not mean telling them everything straight away. You can be honest without giving all the details. The key is to choose words appropriate to the child’s age and to address what they need to understand.
b9ae8e6e26cf53d252621760ca99bb37795779de.french: Je pense qu'il faut privilégier la vérité avec les enfants, mais « toujours » ne signifie pas tout raconter immédiatement. On peut être honnête sans donner tous les détails. L'essentiel est de choisir des mots adaptés à l'âge de l'enfant et de répondre à ce qu'il a besoin de comprendre.

c81d74178c250bc6aa6b74b59c6863894a187117.english: Encouragement does not mean saying everything is perfect. A child can hear that they still need to work on something if their efforts are recognised and someone explains how to do it. A difficulty is not a judgement of their worth.
c81d74178c250bc6aa6b74b59c6863894a187117.french: Encourager ne signifie pas dire que tout est parfait. Un enfant peut entendre qu'il doit encore travailler quelque chose si on reconnaît ses efforts et lui explique comment faire. Une difficulté n'est pas un jugement sur sa valeur.
c81d74178c250bc6aa6b74b59c6863894a187117.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

ceb8b940c75168d599bb8f734fe5a9bae4f48927.english: However, a child should not have to carry the burden of adults' relationship conflicts or financial worries. You can explain a restriction without asking them to solve the problem. And it is better to acknowledge uncertainty than to promise an outcome that is unknown.
ceb8b940c75168d599bb8f734fe5a9bae4f48927.french: Cependant, l'enfant n'a pas à porter les conflits de couple ou les inquiétudes financières des adultes. On peut expliquer une restriction sans lui demander de résoudre le problème. Et mieux vaut reconnaître une incertitude que promettre une issue inconnue.
ceb8b940c75168d599bb8f734fe5a9bae4f48927.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d3feb0fa585358e09139fc13c53f474dd9dfc292.english: If an adult makes up a reason that is easy to refute, the child may subsequently doubt their explanations. When their words remain trustworthy, the child can ask them questions without wondering whether they are hiding the real reason.
d3feb0fa585358e09139fc13c53f474dd9dfc292.french: Si l'adulte invente une raison facile à contredire, l'enfant peut ensuite douter de ses explications. Quand ses paroles restent fiables, l'enfant peut lui poser des questions sans se demander s'il cache la vraie raison.

d8afd6cd9b7c10f9f324cbef72556b681c2941e1.english: A false promise reassures them for a few moments, but may make them doubt the next explanation. An honest answer gives them something to rely on, even when it is not pleasant to hear.
d8afd6cd9b7c10f9f324cbef72556b681c2941e1.french: Une fausse promesse le rassure quelques instants, mais peut lui faire douter de la prochaine explication. Une réponse honnête lui donne un repère, même lorsqu'elle n'est pas agréable à entendre.
d8afd6cd9b7c10f9f324cbef72556b681c2941e1.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

df6f133bcb9bd8c41228a76ee86ed14c339cdd43.english: They know what to expect and can see afterwards that the adult explained things accurately.
df6f133bcb9bd8c41228a76ee86ed14c339cdd43.french: Il sait à quoi s'attendre et constate ensuite que l'adulte lui avait expliqué les choses correctement.
df6f133bcb9bd8c41228a76ee86ed14c339cdd43.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

eaceda664f31f946b1fa5e41bd75eacf311964a9.english: First and foremost, an honest explanation helps the child to trust the adult.
eaceda664f31f946b1fa5e41bd75eacf311964a9.french: Tout d'abord, une explication honnête aide l'enfant à faire confiance à l'adulte.

f40834257cafb1cf347d27b0e4a859e99c294219.english: First, a child must be able to believe what their parents tell them.
f40834257cafb1cf347d27b0e4a859e99c294219.french: D'abord, l'enfant doit pouvoir croire ce que ses parents lui disent.
f40834257cafb1cf347d27b0e4a859e99c294219.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

ffbe53eb091d5c64373bde4f02c0e16779281210.english: Making up an excuse may ease the child’s mind in the moment, but it does not help them understand their difficulties. The adult can acknowledge what went wrong, then work with the child to find ways to move forward.
ffbe53eb091d5c64373bde4f02c0e16779281210.french: Inventer une excuse peut soulager l'enfant sur le moment, mais cela ne l'aide pas à comprendre ses difficultés. L'adulte peut reconnaître ce qui n'a pas marché, puis chercher avec lui comment progresser.

01c06f6891c8b7263618652dcc5a20c014fc85ba.english: The bond still exists, but takes more effort and sometimes leaves them feeling on the sidelines of family life.
01c06f6891c8b7263618652dcc5a20c014fc85ba.french: Le lien existe toujours, mais demande davantage d'efforts et laisse parfois le sentiment d'être à côté de la vie familiale.
01c06f6891c8b7263618652dcc5a20c014fc85ba.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

09084dda2a043714628674533ab1bd23d126b504.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

13009f665d39480da0169fac06a7122afb1d8acc.french: Une personne installée seule peut appeler sa famille le dimanche, puis dîner sans compagnie une fois la conversation terminée. L'appel lui permet de prendre des nouvelles, mais ne remplace pas le repas qu'elle partageait avec ses proches.

17f787362c8f97dad939530100442a39ca9e4e21.english: You need to find time, plan the journey and pay for the ticket. Wanting to be there is therefore not always enough. Even an event planned well in advance may fall at a time when these constraints are too great.
17f787362c8f97dad939530100442a39ca9e4e21.french: Il faut trouver du temps, prévoir le trajet et payer le billet. La volonté d'être présent ne suffit donc pas toujours. Même un événement prévu longtemps à l'avance peut tomber à un moment où ces contraintes sont trop fortes.
17f787362c8f97dad939530100442a39ca9e4e21.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

19fe70afe8cb531c01a7bf1e474d993699822196.english: Being far away can therefore sometimes add to the organisational challenges, quite apart from the feeling of missing loved ones.

1f5104e0ee845c23a4d149517ce5a703ab90bb32.english: A parent finishes work too late to collect his child. Before moving, he relied on the grandparents. This time, he calls a trusted neighbour whom he has already authorised with the school to collect the child.
1f5104e0ee845c23a4d149517ce5a703ab90bb32.french: Un parent finit son travail trop tard pour récupérer son enfant. Avant de déménager, il comptait sur les grands-parents. Cette fois, il appelle une voisine de confiance qu'il a déjà autorisée auprès de l'école.
1f5104e0ee845c23a4d149517ce5a703ab90bb32.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

2756dff8749ba81787c86ca43fa4c3096a79b513.english: Loved ones can offer advice from a distance without being able to travel to see you or provide immediate assistance. You therefore need to find other sources of support and plan ahead more carefully for certain situations.
2756dff8749ba81787c86ca43fa4c3096a79b513.french: Les proches peuvent conseiller à distance sans pouvoir faire un déplacement ou rendre un service immédiat. Il faut alors qu'on trouve d'autres appuis et qu'on prévoie davantage certaines situations.

2a3c91eb32fea52ca662918a4fbe8966dab36ce3.english: Family can listen and give advice over the phone, but cannot always help in practical ways. At first, you do not necessarily know someone you can ask for a favour. It is therefore important to know who to call when something unexpected happens.
2a3c91eb32fea52ca662918a4fbe8966dab36ce3.french: La famille peut écouter et conseiller au téléphone, mais pas toujours intervenir concrètement. Au début, on ne connaît pas forcément quelqu'un à qui demander un service. Il est donc important qu'on sache qui appeler en cas d'imprévu.
2a3c91eb32fea52ca662918a4fbe8966dab36ce3.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

2bc5b37cf1ba625230bc94c180e790716825f247.deepl_english: Loved ones can offer advice from afar without being able to travel to see you or provide immediate assistance. You therefore need to find other sources of support locally and know who to call in the event of an emergency.
2bc5b37cf1ba625230bc94c180e790716825f247.english: People close to us can offer advice from a distance without being able to make a journey or provide immediate help. We then need to find other support locally and know who to call when something unexpected happens.
2bc5b37cf1ba625230bc94c180e790716825f247.french: Les proches peuvent conseiller à distance sans pouvoir faire un déplacement ou rendre un service immédiat. Il faut alors qu'on trouve d'autres appuis sur place et qu'on sache qui appeler en cas d'imprévu.
2bc5b37cf1ba625230bc94c180e790716825f247.review_note: An imprévu can be an unexpected scheduling problem, not an emergency; the unavailable journey need not be a visit to the speaker.

3f770f42d0bb068e361bec96a1f82c97c3b258ed.english: Someone living abroad calls their family every Sunday. Yet, seeing a photo of an impromptu meal at their sister's home, they realise that this moment happened without them.
3f770f42d0bb068e361bec96a1f82c97c3b258ed.french: Une personne installée à l'étranger appelle sa famille chaque dimanche. Pourtant, en voyant une photo du repas improvisé chez sa sœur, elle réalise que ce moment s'est passé sans elle.
3f770f42d0bb068e361bec96a1f82c97c3b258ed.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

40b08266025ed82c4140f29af4770b6db3c1426d.english: In conclusion, living far from one’s family isn’t necessarily easy: you have to cope with missing them, find support locally and plan visits. 40b08266025ed82c4140f29af4770b6db3c1426d.french: En conclusion, vivre loin de sa famille n'est pas forcément facile : il faut gérer le manque, trouver de l'aide sur place et prévoir les visites. Les appels et les liens qu'on crée autour de soi peuvent aider, sans remplacer tous les moments en famille.

40f3ddede5c43dd140151c748aa5deb3f17877e0.english: A woman lives and works an eight-hour train journey from her father's home. To celebrate his birthday with him, she would need to take two days off work. She also cannot afford the train ticket, so she decides not to make the trip.
40f3ddede5c43dd140151c748aa5deb3f17877e0.french: Une femme vit et travaille à huit heures de train de chez son père. Pour fêter son anniversaire avec lui, elle devrait prendre deux jours de congé. Le billet dépasse aussi son budget : elle renonce donc à la visite.
40f3ddede5c43dd140151c748aa5deb3f17877e0.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

4593dd77fe177a78026df2ae17f4079bdeaa73e4.english: Finally, the distance can make it difficult to organise reunions.
4593dd77fe177a78026df2ae17f4079bdeaa73e4.french: Enfin, la distance peut rendre les retrouvailles difficiles à organiser.

48ad61f3e78c982c0899e32d454f72f1cf440d31.english: Living far from your family takes real adjustment. You miss everyday moments, immediate help is no longer available and getting together takes planning. That does not mean regretting your move: you can love your new life while still missing your loved ones.
48ad61f3e78c982c0899e32d454f72f1cf440d31.french: Vivre loin de sa famille demande une vraie adaptation. Les moments ordinaires manquent, l'aide immédiate n'est plus disponible et les retrouvailles demandent une organisation. Cela ne signifie pas regretter son départ : on peut aimer sa nouvelle vie tout en ressentant le manque de ses proches.
48ad61f3e78c982c0899e32d454f72f1cf440d31.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

4a2efc478b643ba6125114dc99560e0a4eaf4b91.english: Next, you need to rebuild a support network close to home.
4a2efc478b643ba6125114dc99560e0a4eaf4b91.french: Ensuite, il faut reconstruire un réseau d'entraide près de chez soi.
4a2efc478b643ba6125114dc99560e0a4eaf4b91.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

55bc3e09b1b3b7387fb6770b2ecef85c6e3621cc.english: Finally, distance sometimes prevents you being there when you want to be.
55bc3e09b1b3b7387fb6770b2ecef85c6e3621cc.french: Enfin, la distance empêche parfois d'être présent au moment souhaité.
55bc3e09b1b3b7387fb6770b2ecef85c6e3621cc.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

5f8a45acbff758cdea2fb6653a7acc646b1136ef.english: The desire to see one another does not, therefore, eliminate the constraints of time and money.
5f8a45acbff758cdea2fb6653a7acc646b1136ef.french: La volonté de se voir ne supprime donc pas les contraintes de temps et de budget.

658f8092fbe557741ea81a168051c1b1b5db8284.english: Reliable friends and good relationships with neighbours make daily life more secure, without replacing family.
658f8092fbe557741ea81a168051c1b1b5db8284.french: Des amis fiables et de bonnes relations de voisinage rendent le quotidien plus sûr, sans remplacer la famille.
658f8092fbe557741ea81a168051c1b1b5db8284.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

6bfb85140d5b4a3181d22dfa234cef146af7140c.english: First, you may come to miss small family routines.
6bfb85140d5b4a3181d22dfa234cef146af7140c.french: D'abord, les petites habitudes familiales peuvent finir par manquer.
6bfb85140d5b4a3181d22dfa234cef146af7140c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

6e2bc1fe66e76cebaf423f94cf99461d7af855ff.french: Une somme d'argent ne dit pas comment on a progressé. Un retour précis attire au contraire l'attention sur une action qu'on peut refaire. L'enfant sait alors sur quoi s'appuyer au prochain contrôle, au lieu d'attendre seulement une récompense.
6e2bc1fe66e76cebaf423f94cf99461d7af855ff.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

7168cb99f2152fbb299a0a6d53ea01d3a2905b11.english: The child may therefore feel that their efforts are not recognised, despite their progress.
7168cb99f2152fbb299a0a6d53ea01d3a2905b11.french: L'enfant peut donc avoir l'impression que ses efforts ne sont pas reconnus, malgré ses progrès.

7277417e5ce57e036611ef0209c9f27026953ab3.english: Next, rewarding only the result can be unfair to a child who is struggling.
7277417e5ce57e036611ef0209c9f27026953ab3.french: Ensuite, récompenser seulement le résultat peut être injuste envers un enfant en difficulté.
7277417e5ce57e036611ef0209c9f27026953ab3.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

7e169eb674d746e63b3805c2975abb6f440e8c32.english: After an improved mark, a parent looks at the marked work: "This time, you reread the instructions and avoided the same mistakes." They then choose a family outing to celebrate the end of term.
7e169eb674d746e63b3805c2975abb6f440e8c32.french: Après une meilleure note, un parent regarde la copie : « Cette fois, tu as relu les consignes et évité les mêmes erreurs. » Ils choisissent ensuite une sortie familiale pour fêter la fin du trimestre.
7e169eb674d746e63b3805c2975abb6f440e8c32.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

7f48677ce37b8d915d643be67479a36e5b073c80.english: Support is therefore focused on the means of making progress, not just on the result.
7f48677ce37b8d915d643be67479a36e5b073c80.french: Le soutien porte ainsi sur les moyens de progresser, pas seulement sur le résultat.

80a3a6300b234ccba24a9350e4ca7093adb61965.english: A pupil’s mark has gone up from 8 to 12 out of 20 after several weeks of hard work. But his parents only give him money once he reaches 15. He has made real progress, without reaching the threshold that triggers the reward.
80a3a6300b234ccba24a9350e4ca7093adb61965.french: Un élève passe de 8 à 12 sur 20 après plusieurs semaines de travail. Mais ses parents ne donnent de l'argent qu'à partir de 15. Il a fait de vrais progrès, sans atteindre le seuil qui déclenche la récompense.

88e7277be59218fa6b36d84bcb342998a8871da9.english: Even if the child remains motivated, a mark does not measure all their effort.
88e7277be59218fa6b36d84bcb342998a8871da9.french: Même si l'enfant reste motivé, la note ne mesure pas tous les efforts.
88e7277be59218fa6b36d84bcb342998a8871da9.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

8c7937eae44fb8de66fc142390a1b218b99e5f8c.english: After an improved mark, a parent looks at the marked work: "This time, you reread the instructions and avoided your usual mistakes." The child decides to keep using this method for the next test.
8c7937eae44fb8de66fc142390a1b218b99e5f8c.french: Après une meilleure note, un parent regarde la copie : « Cette fois, tu as relu les consignes et évité tes erreurs habituelles. » L'enfant décide de garder cette méthode pour le contrôle suivant.
8c7937eae44fb8de66fc142390a1b218b99e5f8c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

9185f418b746ea6e2a855deb1d97d827d3a50cc2.english: First, paying for every good mark risks turning school into a financial transaction.
9185f418b746ea6e2a855deb1d97d827d3a50cc2.french: D'abord, payer chaque bonne note risque de transformer l'école en échange financier.
9185f418b746ea6e2a855deb1d97d827d3a50cc2.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

92922f017d9630e38eab84c8361960119efdd3d8.english: Finally, a reward is no substitute for the support needed to overcome a learning block.
92922f017d9630e38eab84c8361960119efdd3d8.french: Enfin, une prime ne remplace pas l'aide nécessaire pour surmonter un blocage.

93e21f6c80d72741c6536cd47bcef7a51be991f2.english: However, celebrating an achievement or giving an occasional gift is not necessarily a problem. The important thing is not to attach a monetary reward to every achievement, nor to compare children solely on the basis of their marks. We can celebrate progress whilst acknowledging the effort that made it possible.
93e21f6c80d72741c6536cd47bcef7a51be991f2.french: Cependant, célébrer une réussite ou offrir ponctuellement un cadeau n'est pas forcément problématique. L'important est de ne pas fixer un prix à chaque performance ni comparer les enfants uniquement par leurs notes. On peut fêter un progrès tout en reconnaissant les efforts qui l'ont rendu possible.

9769c1112aa8c8711b6e244e53a6951d957c0831.english: This approach may therefore mean that real progress goes unrewarded, even though the child has worked hard.
9769c1112aa8c8711b6e244e53a6951d957c0831.french: Ce système peut donc laisser un progrès réel sans récompense, alors que l'enfant a travaillé.

aa74d9994f30c00f1261419aedb6c90cf46119e9.english: A child receives ten euros for a good maths mark. But they refuse to redo the questions they got wrong in the test, because the corrections aren’t marked and won’t earn them any money.
aa74d9994f30c00f1261419aedb6c90cf46119e9.french: Un enfant reçoit dix euros pour sa bonne note de maths. Mais il refuse de refaire les exercices ratés pendant le contrôle, parce que la correction n'est pas notée et ne lui rapportera pas d'argent.

aa81a632d074e8da5ae734be48cad58bbd223355.english: Not all children have the same strengths or face the same difficulties. If we only offer a reward once a certain mark is achieved, we risk overlooking the efforts of a child who is progressing more slowly.
aa81a632d074e8da5ae734be48cad58bbd223355.french: Les enfants n'ont pas tous les mêmes facilités ni les mêmes difficultés. Si l'on paie seulement à partir d'une certaine note, on risque de ne pas remarquer les efforts d'un enfant qui progresse plus lentement.

b8bca2c33b4ce3aa3074e6b1f1a4df417729d747.english: You may get an immediate result without building a habit that continues when you stop paying.
b8bca2c33b4ce3aa3074e6b1f1a4df417729d747.french: On obtient peut-être un résultat immédiat, sans construire une habitude qui continue lorsqu'on ne paie plus.
b8bca2c33b4ce3aa3074e6b1f1a4df417729d747.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

c412a174fe4012027bb94b520fb5a219568455fb.english: A parent promises ten euros for every good mark. Before preparing a presentation that will not be marked, their child asks: "Do I get anything for this too?" The child is thinking about payment rather than the topic.
c412a174fe4012027bb94b520fb5a219568455fb.french: Un parent promet dix euros pour chaque bonne note. Avant de préparer un exposé non noté, son enfant demande : « Ça rapporte aussi quelque chose ? » Il pense au paiement plutôt qu'au sujet.
c412a174fe4012027bb94b520fb5a219568455fb.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

c5df99fdb5464ef3d96295ee63e45dc590828bc6.english: The child may think mainly about what they will earn rather than what they have understood. The risk is that the reward takes priority over learning: anything that earns nothing then seems less important to them.
c5df99fdb5464ef3d96295ee63e45dc590828bc6.french: L'enfant peut surtout penser à ce qu'il gagnera, plutôt qu'à ce qu'il a compris. Le risque est de faire passer la récompense avant l'apprentissage : ce qui ne rapporte rien lui semble alors moins important.
c5df99fdb5464ef3d96295ee63e45dc590828bc6.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d5449cef3ddf6b8677ba895977fb4a3e5ab35dbc.english: In short, I prefer to encourage hard work and celebrate progress. The main thing is to help children understand why they are learning and how they can improve.
d5449cef3ddf6b8677ba895977fb4a3e5ab35dbc.french: Bref, je préfère encourager le travail et célébrer les progrès. L'essentiel est d'aider l'enfant à comprendre pourquoi il apprend et comment il peut s'améliorer.
d5449cef3ddf6b8677ba895977fb4a3e5ab35dbc.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d91c9784cd155b28ba4c81a3ab13cc7cf1feb5a0.deepl_english: In conclusion, you can celebrate a good mark without systematically rewarding it. I prefer to recognise progress, encourage a desire to learn and help the child where they need it.
d91c9784cd155b28ba4c81a3ab13cc7cf1feb5a0.english: In conclusion, you can celebrate a good mark without systematically paying for it. I prefer to recognise progress, encourage a desire to learn and help the child where they need it.
d91c9784cd155b28ba4c81a3ab13cc7cf1feb5a0.french: En conclusion, on peut fêter une bonne note sans la payer systématiquement. Je préfère reconnaître les progrès, encourager l'envie d'apprendre et aider l'enfant là où il en a besoin.
d91c9784cd155b28ba4c81a3ab13cc7cf1feb5a0.review_note: The source distinguishes celebrating a mark from paying money, not from all forms of rewarding it.

da72ae30b75fbc6b8c0219df968c247113525318.english: When a child does not understand an instruction or a method, increasing the reward does not show them how to proceed. We must first identify the difficulty and offer appropriate support.
da72ae30b75fbc6b8c0219df968c247113525318.french: Quand l'enfant ne comprend pas une consigne ou une méthode, augmenter la récompense ne lui montre pas comment procéder. Il faut d'abord repérer la difficulté et proposer un appui adapté.

e26ee6c7a7728e485ac34e34d138e0f4285c2837.english: I understand that a parent might want to encourage their child, but I wouldn’t give money for every good mark. This risks prioritising the reward over learning and failing to recognise all the effort involved. Above all, money is no substitute for the support a child might need.
e26ee6c7a7728e485ac34e34d138e0f4285c2837.french: Je comprends qu'un parent veuille encourager son enfant, mais je ne donnerais pas d'argent pour chaque bonne note. Cela risque de faire passer la récompense avant l'apprentissage et de ne pas reconnaître tous les efforts. Surtout, l'argent ne remplace pas l'aide dont un enfant peut avoir besoin.

eb05409da393f1cdb21f682e4b86976c7089bbea.english: The child understands what helped them improve and can feel proud of it, regardless of any sum of money.
eb05409da393f1cdb21f682e4b86976c7089bbea.french: L'enfant comprend ce qui l'a fait progresser et peut en être fier, indépendamment d'une somme d'argent.
eb05409da393f1cdb21f682e4b86976c7089bbea.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.
